question: 固定width32、输入/标签、初始参数与规则、depth1/2/4/6、T4096及full-batch SGD，仅将eta=.005升至.02；全核12/12两倍内是否保留？

recipe.target: raw=x0+0.5*x0*x1; y=(raw-mean)/RMS; same x/y for all cells
recipe.architecture: depth hidden Linear+SiLU then scalar Linear head; all Linear no bias, no LN, no residual
recipe.initialization: hidden layer l seed=init_seed+10000*l, normal*sqrt(2/fan_in); head seed=init_seed+900000, normal/sqrt(width); exactly same width32 initial weights as r034, common prefixes and head across depths

definitions.J_l: output Jacobian w.r.t. parameter group l
definitions.frozen_t50: first integer t with sum_i energy_i*(1-eta*lambda_i)^(2t)<=0.5, exact eigenspectrum search up to 2^60; null energy >=0.5 means unreachable
definitions.t_slow: max_l frozen_t50(K_l), infinite if any group unreachable
definitions.t_actual: first integer t=1..4096 with loss(t)<=loss(0)/2; otherwise right-censored >4096
definitions.parameter_groups: one weight matrix per hidden layer plus head; head is included in both candidates
definitions.eigenvalue_rule: lambda <= 1e-12*max(lambda_max,1e-30) treated as zero; negative lambda < -1e-10*max(lambda_max,1e-30) invalid; eta*lambda_max>=2 unstable
definitions.r_t: f_t(x)-y; a common output residual, no separate hidden-layer loss
definitions.q_l: r_t^T K_l r_t/(r_t^T r_t), a local residual direction rate
definitions.layer_residual_energy: (V_l^T r_t)^2 in layer output-space eigenbasis; not layer loss

predictions.text: eta=.02、width32下最慢参数组12/12为有限候选且候选/实际T50>2。
predictions.criterion: 12/12 complete cell with finite candidate, finite actual and ratio>2; unstable/unreachable/diverged/censored do not support finite overestimation.

predictions.text: eta从.005升至.02后，全核保留12/12在两倍内：四个深度各3/3满足.5<=t_sum/t_actual<=2。
predictions.criterion: All 12 cells complete with finite actual and candidate; sum_comparison pass count exactly 12, four depths 3/3.

decision_rules.units: 4 depth recipes x 3 init seeds = 12 training cells; seeds are repeats
decision_rules.censoring: Twofold comparison: unreachable candidate with finite actual fails; actual>4096 and finite candidate<=2048 fails, other censored cases unresolved. P1/P2 require complete finite cells. Any complete unstable/unreachable slowest, or finite slowest ratio<=2, refutes P1; any resolved twofold fail refutes P2; unresolved cells prevent support. Per-depth P2 requires 3/3 passes and is refuted by any fail.
decision_rules.scope: development only; 4 depth recipes x 3 init repeats; only eta .005 -> .02 changes; same width32 x/y, parameters, initial functions and initial Jacobians/kernels. No depth monotonicity/causal/width mechanism/unseen-depth/OOD claims.
decision_rules.limits: K=sum K_l and fixed-kernel recursion are known identities; spectra depend on parameterization; kernel drift and residual-direction changes are not intervened
decision_rules.statistics: all seed ratios and same-seed adjacent-depth differences; within-depth t95 intervals only all finite; initialization uncertainty only, no pooled iid p value
decision_rules.failure: diverged training or invalid_psd/search_limit candidates unresolved; preserve errors, no success overwrite. unstable candidates fail the twofold criterion and cannot support the finite ratio>2 prediction.
decision_rules.eta_branch: eta*lambda_max>=2: candidate unstable, twofold fail, cannot support P1; slowest retains unstable if any group unstable. Known old development maximum multiplied by four predicts .7713375275328759<2; this is pre-registration arithmetic, not blind discovery or training stability proof.

execution.resume: existing JSON and NPZ contract/hash must match; orphan NPZ is error
